title: Chapter layout
what: The Engine panel's choice between one flat track per chapter and a folder with a track per voice now also sits in Settings, under Recording & DAW, with a Reset beside it.
why: The setting lived only on the Engine panel. Both places now change the same value, live: change it in one and the other follows.
caption: Settings › Recording & DAW › Chapter sync: Chapter layout set to Voice folders, marked Changed, with its Reset.

title: Chapter sync and Voices
what: Chapter sync on or off, and which character each voice track records, now also sit in Settings, one row each under Chapter sync.
why: Both were only on the Engine panel. The Voices table appears only when the layout is Voice folders, so a flat project is not shown a table it cannot use.
caption: Settings › Recording & DAW › Chapter sync: Sync chapters to tracks On, and the Voices table for Chapter 1 with its keys, tracks and characters.

title: Booth text size
what: How large the chapter is drawn in the Booth, from 24 to 72 px, is now a slider in Settings, under Appearance & keys › Look.
why: The size was only changed inside the Booth. Settings and the Booth now change the same size.
caption: Settings › Appearance & keys › Look: the Booth text size slider.

title: Editing playback
what: The Editing page's playback speed, volume, silence and output device are now in Settings, under Appearance & keys › Listening.
why: These were only in the Editing page's Output popover. A saved output that is not connected stays chosen, with a note.
caption: Settings › Appearance & keys › Listening: Editing playback with speed, volume, silence and the output device.

title: Effects coverage cap
what: The share of a chapter's audio that effects may cover (10% until changed) is now a number in Settings, under Recording & DAW › Effects, for the computer or for one project.
why: The cap was only editable on the Editing page. Settings now offers the same value, with Override for this project.
caption: Settings › Recording & DAW › Effects: the effects coverage cap.

title: Story Bible order
what: Which entries the Story Bible lists first (name, kind, book order, most or least mentioned) is now a select in Settings, under Appearance & keys › Look, with a Reset.
why: The order was kept from the Story Bible's headers and Sort menu and had no Settings row. All three change the same order.
caption: Settings › Appearance & keys › Look: Story Bible order set to Most mentioned, marked Changed, with its Reset.

title: First-use tips
what: How many of the short tips you have dismissed is shown in Settings, under App & updates › Tips, with Show tips again, which brings every tip back.
why: Dismissing a tip was permanent and could not be undone anywhere. Show tips again forgets them all, with no restart.
caption: Settings › App & updates › Tips: 1 dismissed, marked Changed, with Show tips again.

title: Schedule basis
what: Whether the hours on Production and Schedule use the standard pace or your own measured pace is now a choice in Settings, under Project › Schedule.
why: The choice was only in the Production target popover. Settings and the popover now change the same choice.
caption: Settings › Project › Schedule: Schedule basis set to Your own pace, marked Changed.
